confidenceLegend.CONFIRMED_STATIC: Cited file:line was opened and read directly
confidenceLegend.CONFIRMED_RUNTIME: Observed via an actual HTTP request/response or server log line captured this session
confidenceLegend.INFERRED: Plausible from naming/structure but not directly verified by opening the file

meta.coverageNote: This canonical graph prioritizes: (a) every node/edge implicated in a CONFIRMED finding, (b) all 29 backend router mounts and their controller/service targets, (c) all 64 models with ref edges, (d) the two frontends' API-call edges for every page/component that touches cases/forms/auth/questionnaire/OCR. It does NOT include every one of the ~350 individual routes as separate edges (that full list lives in docs/architecture/ROUTE-TABLE.md and the Phase-2 agent outputs) -- routes are represented at the router-mount and named-endpoint level needed to explain confirmed findings. This is disclosed explicitly per the 'no false full-audit claim' rule -- see COVERAGE.md.
